label: GLM-5.3-Flash MLX 4-bit (TensorFold 1.2.8 --vision, M3 Ultra)

engine.name: tensorfold
engine.vision: enabled (--vision, up to 64 images per request; PNG built in, JPEG via libjpeg-turbo 3.1.4.1)

verify_before_runs: model_id and reasoning parameter accepted (smoke run shows reasoning tokens)
engine flags in record/host/start.txt match engine block
prefix cache hits visible in raw usage
notes: Sampling: engine/pack defaults (TensorFold reports temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95); the exact request and response are in record/raw. GLM on one Mac is outside TensorFold's qualified two-Mac setup and needs GLM_LOAD_LIMIT_GB above its 70%-of-RAM default to load this 181.7 GB pack. The 2026-11-14 attempt ran without --vision and failed on the first preview screenshot (HTTP 400); this setup adds --vision, --vision-max-images 64 and the pinned JPEG decoder (the 2026-11-15 first retry failed on a JPEG preview and on a 5-image request).
